provenance.description: Frozen chart contracts before the native Valibot migration. EntitySchema.options were obtained from the real pre-migration wrappers and Chart.schemaToEntity, without a database connection.
provenance.nonJsonNormalization: Undefined, bigint, functions, dates, regexes and non-finite numbers use explicit tagged values; symbols fail. Object entries and array order are retained.
provenance.entityCapture: Only the unrelated miRepository import was stubbed; real TypeORM EntitySchema and Chart.schemaToEntity were executed.
